answer: Standing is an ocean that only counts when a stranger asks a hard question: each epoch’s work must be interrogated by an established stranger who asks a question only someone who really did the work could answer. A wharf only lets in ships whose captains can answer hard questions, and a juniper only stands when strangers ask hard questions about it — a farm of a thousand fakes cannot answer hard questions about work they never did, so their oceans never count, and one epoch of unquestioned work adds nothing.
